summary: VALIDATE outcome: passed. All four quality gates green at the expected counts (253+124=377 passed, 1 skipped), both linters clean, `openspec validate --strict` valid. decisions: Marked Smoke Tests, Security and E2E Tests as 'not applicable' rather than 'skipped', per gate_logic.py's distinction and the dispatch brief's explicit instruction, since this change has no deployable surface.

Treated the harness's refusal of git ops (cd+git and git -C) AND of the Edit/Write tools against the managed worktree as the documented intermittent bug, per the dispatch brief: did not diagnose it further, used plain-Bash python one-liners to make and revert the spot-check mutations and to place the report/handoff files, and will push from this agent's own worktree rather than committing in place.

Judged all four of scenarios 12-15 as having REAL (discriminating) coverage based on deliberate break-and-confirm spot-checks rather than static reading of assertions alone, per the phase's explicit instruction not to trust a green test on sight.

Verified the D4 byte-unchanged guard by diffing extracted git blobs rather than `git diff`, since git could not be invoked against the feature worktree at all; this is evidentially equivalent (same bytes compared) even though the invocation shape differs from the brief's suggested command.
